frontmatter.title: Slugifying Text in Bash
frontmatter.subheading: Learn how to convert text into URL-friendly slugs and create files with slugified names using Bash scripting.
frontmatter.excerpt: Looking for an easy way to slugify text for URL or file naming? Our comprehensive guide teaches you how to write a Bash script to transform any text into a URL-friendly slug and create files with slugified names.
